scope: Retained successful Laplace-mode sessions only; prompt/stream C1 warmups excluded from SDG metrics.
resource_accounting: No SDG predictive warmups were scheduled in retained successful runs, so SDG-attributable discard count and resource integrals are zero for these logs. Per-warmup CPU and memory were not recorded; host wave samples cannot attribute resources to an individual warmup. Intent-aware prompt/stream C1 warmups are a separate mechanism and are excluded.
denominator_definition: Candidate-target denominator is the sum of candidate_count over predictive calls. The retained logs emit zero candidates, so hit rate has a zero denominator. False-positive denominator is accepted predictive-stage prewarm_schedule events; zero were recorded.
